x-m-el-sta-05.title: Ukujula okumbalwa nokuninzi: ithuba okanye ukukhohlisa?
x-m-el-sta-05.goal: Usebenzisa idatha yesimyuleyitha, gweba umbono osemva kovavanyo lwengcamango: nokuba umlinganiselo ufanayo, kunzima kangakanani ukuchaza isiphumo 'ngethuba' kuxhomekeke kwinani lezilingo.
x-m-el-sta-05.material: UJihoon waphosa imali yemali wathi, 'Ndicinga ukuba le mali yenzelwe ukuba ihlale ibe nentloko ngakumbi!' Usebenze isimyuleyitha sekhompyutha ukubona ukuba isiphumo esinjalo senzeka kangaphi ngemali ethe tye (imali apho intloko nomsila zinethuba elilinganayo). Iziphumo zesimyuleyitha: (a) Ukuphosa imali ethe tye amaxesha ali-10 kwaphindwa amaxesha ali-1000, kwaza kwavela iintloko ezi-7 okanye ngaphezulu kuma-170 malunga. (b) Ukuphosa imali ethe tye amaxesha ali-100 kwaphindwa amaxesha ali-1000, kwaye iintloko ezingama-70 okanye ngaphezulu azizange zivele kwanye. Iziphumo zokwenyani zikaJihoon yiMeko A (iintloko ezi-7 kwiziphosa ezili-10) neMeko B (iintloko ezingama-70 kwiziphosa ezili-100).

x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.a: Kwisimyuleyitha (a), nemali ethe tye yanika iintloko ezi-7 okanye ngaphezulu kwezili-10 kuma-170 malunga kwama-1000. Isiphumo esenzeka rhoqo asothusi.

x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.explain: Xa n isuka kwi-100 ukuya kwi-400, ngamaxesha ama-4 inkulu, √n iba ngamaxesha ama-2 inkulu, ngoko umda wempazamo unqunyulwa phakathi, ukusuka kwimizuzu emi-4 ukuya kwimizuzu emi-2.
